subject.title: fix(agents): emit diagnostic when sessions_yield parks without continuation evidence

question: Should active descendant runs and successful cron additions permanently count as sufficient evidence to suppress the bare-yield diagnostic for this session?
rationale: Source and tests can prove the implementation is internally consistent, but they cannot establish whether those two asynchronous states are guaranteed product-level continuation sources for the current interactive session.

options.title: Approve Current Evidence Set
options.body: Treat the six implemented evidence classes as the canonical diagnostic-suppression contract and merge after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Limit suppression to sources guaranteed to wake or visibly serve the current session, then add regression cases for excluded descendants or cron work.

options.title: Defer to Tool Enforcement
options.body: Pause this mitigation and redesign `sessions_yield` to reject invalid calls once continuation semantics and state plumbing are explicitly specified.

recommendation.title: Approve Current Evidence Set
recommendation.body: Treat the six implemented evidence classes as the canonical diagnostic-suppression contract and merge after exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns the yielded-parent lifecycle distinction most directly affected by this contract choice.
